description: Uniform random integers in any range you give, with or without repeats. Rejection sampling, so the ends of the range are not slightly less likely - which is what happens with modulo. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

count.description: How many to draw, 1-100. Defaults to 1.

unique.description: No repeats. Needs a range at least as wide as count.
